{{Quote|Who is the mercenary warlord?''"<br />"''Beats me. Someone who, it says here, "led a brutal but unsuccessful assault on the Empire's outpost on Lok, commanded by General Otto."|A spacer and [[Mozo Bondog]]|<ref name="SWG:MB" />}}
A '''mercenary warlord''' hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was captured after a brutal but unsuccessful assault on the [[Imperial Outpost (Lok)|Imperial Outpost]] on Lok. The warlord ended up in the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial Prison]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], which was overseen by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Olof]] and Warden [[Vinzel Haylon]]. The warlord managed to escape, stealing an old [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] from a prison [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Mozo Bondog]]. Although that jetpack was non-functional at the time, it had once belonged to the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Viume Loggun]], and Bondog nursed a sentimental attachment to it. Because of his theft, the mercenary warlord was hunted by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] whom Bondog had hired to kill him. The two had a fight, which resulted in the warlord's demise.<ref name="SWG:MB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMercenaryCommander.jpg|thumb|250px|Every possible depictions of the mercenary warlord]]
Mozo Bondog was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
